children: Adient has tapped board member Peter Carlin to be the automotive-seating company's next chief financial officer.
Adient on Friday said Carlin, a director since 2018, will step down from the board on Oct. 1 and join the Dublin-based company as vice president of finance.
Carlin, 54 years old, will become executive vice president and chief financial officer on Nov. 16, succeeding Mark Oswald, the company said.
Adient earlier this year said Oswald, who has been finance chief since 2024, was planning to leave the company by the end of the year.
Adient said Carlin will receive an annual base salary of $820,000 and an annual bonus with a target of 100% of his base pay.
